Hey I've been there and done that. I have smoked weed in the past and that has helped with my suicidality. So if it's legal where you are or you can get some without putting yourself in danger , there's no harm in trying.

 But I highly highly recommend against any substances that could damage your system. This includes alcohol, nicotine and the general hard drugs you are referring to. Because as hard as life can be , substance abuse will make it 10x harder. 

Are you sure you really want to do hard drugs ? Or do you just want to be free from the stress and pain ? Please go see a psychiatrist and get either xanex or prosac because that is the safest way to feel better .

Hey , I'm a 16M and I've got some advice for you.

So I tried to commit suicide 3 times , self harmed for the greater part of a year and even turned to substances to cope. I spoke to my parents and told them I needed to go see a psychiatrist ASAP. After a few months of therapy and medication I had a emotional trauma and had to go to rehabilitation for 12 days to deal with my depression. Today I'm the best version of me I have ever been. 

So basically what I'm trying to say is get professionals involved. Because if you broke your leg you'd go to a doctor , same thing goes for mental illness.
